cases.prompt: In our Next.js App Router app, decide which of these components should be Server Components and where the "use client" boundary belongs.
The dashboard route in our Next.js app loads slowly because the data fetches run one after another; remove the request waterfall.
The React bundle is too big because the rich text editor is imported eagerly; code-split it with next/dynamic.
This React list re-renders every row on each keystroke; reduce the wasted re-renders.
We have a useEffect that copies props into state in this React component; is that the right pattern?
Add Suspense streaming so the Next.js product page shell renders before the reviews section finishes loading.
Review the fetch caching and revalidation choices in our Next.js App Router data layer.
Our React context provider re-renders the whole tree on every update; how should we split it?
This React component uses the array index as the key for a filterable list; fix the rendering bug.
Build a new Next.js App Router route that fetches on the server and passes serialisable props to a small client component.
Add a paginated REST endpoint for the orders resource in our Django service.
Write a database migration that adds a nullable column and backfills it.
Refactor this Vue 3 composable so it stops re-computing on every reactive change.
Convert this Svelte store to use derived stores instead of manual subscriptions.
Nudge the footer margin by 4px in the stylesheet so it matches the spec.
Add a --dry-run flag to our Python command line data importer.
Split the CI test job into two parallel groups and cache the dependency install.
Fix the event handler leak in this legacy jQuery carousel widget.
Fix the typo in the confirmation email body text.
Profile and reduce the p99 latency of the Go pricing service.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The deterministic fixture test verifies that a project that has not enabled react-next-best-practices has no derived skill surface, and that enabling the canonical descriptor materializes exactly the marker generated from it for each supported provider.
Every non-React frontend, backend, and infrastructure control prompt in this fixture is labelled not-trigger, so an incompatible or opted-out project receives no React/Next guidance from it.
